title: 01 Matrix
summary: For an m x n binary matrix, provide the shortest distance to the nearest 0 for each cell.
statement: For an m x n binary matrix, provide the shortest distance to the nearest 0 for each cell. Adjacent cells share a distance of 1.
constraints: mat contains 0 and 1 and has at least one zero.
hints: Distance expands one grid edge at a time.
Start every zero simultaneously so the first visit is nearest.
Queue all zeros at distance zero, then BFS into unvisited cells.
Multi-source BFS assigns each cell at its shortest arrival because BFS processes increasing path length.
editorial: Multi-source BFS assigns each cell at its shortest arrival because BFS processes increasing path length.

tests.explanation: Every 1 touches a zero, so its distance is one.
The lower row inherits increasing distances 1, 2, 1 from the nearest zeros.
